decisions.reason: Product A is close to the firm's established offer, has its own website page indicating visible public commitment and sunk investment, and there are no reported disappointing results, so escalation of commitment makes dropping very unlikely.

Although Product B is distant from the established offer and less central to the announced direction, the firm has already invested and publicly committed by giving it its own page, so escalation of commitment still favors keeping it, albeit with a somewhat higher drop probability.
Product C is close to the established offer and has its own page showing visible commitment, so escalation of commitment makes dropping very unlikely.

Although Product D builds on the established offer, it has only been mentioned rather than given its own page, indicating less visible public commitment, so escalation of commitment yields a somewhat higher but still low probability of dropping.
